name: @epoch/adapter-github
description: Epoch Hosted Software-Workspace adapter (W029 reference set) — the typed, provider-neutral reference adapter for hosted software-workspace state (source + action categories): deterministic projection of hosted workspace snapshots (revisions, content trees, work-item references) as content-addressed OBSERVATION records over W002 assertion conventions (source, timestamp, confidence, validity; provenance carrying adapter identity + source digest), and a typed change-proposal action surface routed EXCLUSIVELY through the W022 action-authority seam (the adapter never executes; outcomes are the authority's typed decision/outcome records; gateway-bypass-rejected). Provider vocabulary stays in src/provider (blocklist-tested). In-memory reference behavior: NO network, NO live provider calls, NO real side effects; fixtures stand in for provider payloads.
